title: FALCON Yemen 2020: Research Software and Source Provenance (Curated Edition)

creators.name: Al-Tayar, Ezzaldeen
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology, Taiz University, Taiz, Yemen

description: Curated FALCON Yemen 2020 research software and public source-link/checksum provenance. The author-owned software under Code/ is made available under the MIT License (Code/LICENSE). RIPE RIS and IODA source datasets and images are not included or relicensed. Internal reviewer materials, manuscript drafts, provider-origin JSON and source-derived peer-prefix CSV data are excluded. This software-only release is not a complete standalone deposit of the numerical evidence for the pre-submission research manuscript.
